selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to see after leaving the classroom?
questions.answer: He wanted to see how faith grows stronger and rises to a clearer level.

questions.question: Who called the traveler to a new place?
questions.answer: Many spiritual guides called him.

questions.question: What kind of place did he enter?
questions.answer: He entered a very large spiritual gathering place for worship, teaching, and remembrance.

questions.question: Under whose path were those spiritual guides trying to reach the truth?
questions.answer: They were following the way of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What were those guides saying together?
questions.answer: They were declaring that Allah is One.

questions.question: What two things supported their message?
questions.answer: Their spiritual witnessing and the special gifts and signs they were given supported it.

questions.question: What comparison is used to help explain how clear this truth was?
questions.answer: It is compared to knowing the sun by its light and colors.

questions.question: What three groups are shown as agreeing about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: The prophets, the purified scholars, and the saints are shown as agreeing.

questions.question: Why is their agreement such a strong proof?
questions.answer: Because many truthful and guided people, from different paths, all reached the same belief.

questions.question: What short lesson is given from the hospice experience?
questions.answer: The saints’ united testimony points to Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.

questions.question: Why did the traveler leave the classroom and go on further?
questions.answer: He wanted stronger faith and a higher kind of certainty.

questions.question: What were the spiritual guides doing in that gathering place?
questions.answer: They were seeking the truth and reaching a level of faith based on spiritual seeing.

questions.question: How is the gathering place described?
questions.answer: It is described as very bright, very large, and made up of many smaller spiritual places joined together.

questions.question: What kind of people were the spiritual guides?
questions.answer: They were saintly people known for deep spiritual insight and amazing deeds.

questions.question: What truth did they all agree on?
questions.answer: They all agreed that Allah necessarily exists and that He is One.

questions.question: Why did the traveler think their shared belief mattered so much?
questions.answer: He saw that when so many holy and wise people agree, their agreement shows a truth very clearly.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the different paths of the saints?
questions.answer: Their ways may differ, but they all come from the same divine light.

questions.question: What image is used for those different paths and colors?
questions.answer: The passage uses the image of many colors shining from one source of light.

questions.question: What bigger conclusion did the traveler reach from seeing the prophets, scholars, and saints agree?
questions.answer: He understood that their combined agreement is an extremely bright proof of Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What benefit did the traveler gain from this visit?
questions.answer: He gained a stronger faith through the united witness of the saints.

questions.question: What was the traveler hoping to gain in this new stage of his journey?
questions.answer: He hoped to move from knowing by evidence to a clearer and more direct certainty.

questions.question: Who invited him this time?
questions.answer: Great numbers of spiritual guides invited him.

questions.question: What was special about these guides’ connection to Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: They were reaching truth under his guidance and example.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice about their statement about Allah?
questions.answer: He noticed that they all said the same thing about Allah’s oneness.
